=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3537-3642 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new merge-arm calls `rb_judge_merge_open_guard start "${_pr_json:-}"` and the closed-exit `rb_judge_merge_open_guard start ... || true` run without first checking `RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA`, which is resolved by `git rev-parse HEAD || echo ""`. If the SHA is empty or not 40-hex, `_pr_merge_open_guard` fails input validation at pr_checks_lib.sh:1001, so a closed PR logs `reason=pr_state_unavailable` instead of `reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>`, and the lease release at review_rb_judge.sh:3211-3212 is skipped.
  WHY: Nothing merges, so the outcome is safe, but the skip line gives the wrong reason and a held lease waits for the merge-train `holder_closed` sweep. The terminal arm validates at line 3664; the trigger is narrow (source severity NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 called a similar pass-1 claim incorrect, citing validation at lines 3474-3479 / line 3474.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "On a closed PR the job ends with success, merges nothing, releases the lease if it holds it, and logs one line: AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED pr=<n> head_sha=<sha> reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>." (Goal 3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup arm, `elif [ "${PR_STATE}" = "closed" ]; then` branch at lines 4229-4233
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The branch at 4229-4233 only echoes a `::warning::` about skipping follow-up creation. It never calls `rb_judge_merge_open_guard start "${_pr_json:-}"`, although `_pr_json` was already read at line 4169, so the call needs no API request. As a result it emits no `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED ... reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>` and does not release a held lease. The last run added this to the merge arm (3534-3542, 3636-3643) and the terminal arm (3684-3687, 3773-3780) but not here. The assertion at tests/test_pr_merge_state_guard.py:529-530 and agents.d/10049-merge-open-pr-guard.md line 3 cover only the merge and terminal sites. test_merge_with_followup_skips_when_pr_closed_without_merge does not assert the skip line, so this is also a test gap. Severity: MAJOR from sonnet, minimax and luna; NIT from glm. glm says no lease is held by this invocation in the 4229 branch, so the release is moot there.
- requirement: "When the state cannot be read (rate limit, 5xx), the job does not merge. It logs reason=pr_state_unavailable and leaves the PR for the next review run." (Goal 4)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup arm, final empty-PR_STATE `else` at lines 4403-4405
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: When the read at line 4169 fails it falls back to '{}', which leaves PR_STATE empty. The `else` at 4403-4405 then emits only a generic warning and `judge_skip_reason=mergeability_pending`, with no `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED ... reason=pr_state_unavailable`. The same failed-read case got this line in both sibling arms. Severity: MAJOR from sonnet and luna; NIT from glm.
- requirement: "The same check runs when the job starts and when it takes or asks for the merge lease, so a closed PR does not take the lease, does not update its branch and does not wait on checks." (Goal 2)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup arm, before `PR_BASE_SYNC_INLINE_CALLER=true _pr_base_fresh_for_merge` at lines 4307-4308
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The first guard call is at line 4326. Before it, `_pr_checks_completed` runs at lines 4263-4265 and `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` plus the inline `_pr_base_sync_inline_merge` run at 4307-4308. These can take the lease, update the branch, or wait on checks (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` lines 2782-2805). The last run added the start check at 3537 and 3684 but not here. `PR_BASE_SYNC_INLINE_CALLER=true` at line 4308 contradicts the editor's "no wait window" deferral. Severity: MAJOR from luna and glm; NIT from sonnet, which notes the risk is limited because PR_STATE=open from line 4169 is already required.
- requirement: "Every job that merges a PR in the review workflow reads the PR immediately before the merge and proceeds only when state == open, the PR is not a draft, and the head SHA equals the SHA the job is bound to."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup path immediately before its `gh pr merge` call at line 4378
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The guard runs at line 4326. Between it and the merge call at line 4378 the path runs the follow-up guard, posts the head-gate status and calls `rb_judge_sync_merge_guard`, and no live state/head guard runs again after those steps. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dismissed this as residual risk accepted in the previous round, saying the window between 4326 and 4378 has no wait.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

(Goal 3) and "when the state cannot be read (rate limit, 5xx), the job does not merge. It logs reason=pr_state_unavailable" (Goal 4)
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup arm. The closed branch is at lines 4229-4233; the final `else` at lines 4403-4405 handles an empty PR_STATE.
  Evidence of absence: The closed branch only echoes a `::warning::` and never calls `rb_judge_merge_open_guard start "${_pr_json:-}"`, even though `_pr_json` comes from line 4169. So it emits no pr_closed line and never releases a lease that may be held or queued from `rb_judge_mark_merge_pending merge_with_followup` at line 4318. The `else` at 4403-4405 emits only `judge_skip_reason=mergeability_pending`, with no pr_state_unavailable line. The suggested fix (about 6 lines) mirrors 3636-3643.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The same check runs when the job starts and when it takes or asks for the merge lease, so a closed PR does not take the lease, does not update its branch and does not wait on checks." (Goal 2)
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup arm, before the `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` elif at lines 4307-4308.
  Evidence of absence: The only guard is at line 4326, after the freshness/lease call at 4308. So a draft PR, or a PR whose head moved, can still ask for the lease or a branch update. Risk is limited because PR_STATE=open from line 4169 is required. Suggested fix (about 3 lines): insert an `elif ... ! rb_judge_merge_open_guard start "${_pr_json:-}"` before 4307.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING (risk score 1): scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup arm, lines 4229-4233 and 4403-4405. Add the guard call or the pr_state_unavailable echo (about 6 lines).
